_meta.purpose: 50 general-audience-judgeable prompts for the Prolific eval. Each prompt is something any literate adult can evaluate based on common knowledge, writing quality, helpfulness, or emotional appropriateness — without specialized credentials.
_meta.filtered_out: framework comparisons, programming-language-specific, medical/legal/financial advice, specialized domain content, niche cultural references

prompts.text: Write the opening line of a noir detective novel.
Write a short poem about a winter morning.
Compose a haiku about autumn.
Write an opening for a fantasy story set in an underwater city.
Write a thank-you message to a teacher who changed your life.
Describe what a Sunday morning feels like in 5 sentences.
Write a short scene where two strangers connect at a bus stop.
Write the first paragraph of a memoir about growing up in a small town.
I'm feeling overwhelmed at work. Any advice?
I think my friend is upset with me but won't say why. What should I do?
I've been struggling to sleep lately. What might help?
How do I have a difficult conversation with my partner about something that's been bothering me?
I'm nervous about a job interview tomorrow. Any tips to calm down?
My neighbor plays loud music late at night. How should I approach it?
I keep procrastinating on important tasks. What can I do?
How do I stay motivated when working on a long project that doesn't have an end in sight?
Explain photosynthesis to a 10-year-old.
Explain how vaccines work in simple terms.
Why do leaves change color in autumn? Keep it short.
Explain why ice floats on water in a way a kid would understand.
What is gravity, in simple terms?
Explain the water cycle in 4 sentences.
Why do we yawn when we see other people yawn?
How does the moon affect the tides? Give an intuitive explanation.
Describe the smell of rain in 3 sentences.
Describe the sound of a forest at dawn.
Describe the taste of fresh-baked bread.
Describe the feeling of walking on warm sand.
Describe what a thunderstorm sounds like to someone who's never heard one.
Convince me, in one paragraph, to learn a new language.
Argue against the idea that 'money can't buy happiness.'
Make a case for reading paper books over e-books.
Convince someone to start journaling daily.
Argue that walking is an underrated form of exercise.
Persuade me to try cooking at home more often.
Make a brief case for taking more breaks during work.
Write a short, kind reply to a friend who just lost their job.
Write a sympathetic message to someone going through a breakup.
Write an encouraging note to a friend starting a new job.
Write a thoughtful birthday message for a parent.
Write a brief condolence message to a colleague who lost a pet.
Plan one week of dinners for someone trying to eat more vegetables.
Plan a perfect weekend day for someone who loves being outdoors.
Plan a simple morning routine to start the day well.
Plan a 3-day visit to your favorite city for a friend who's never been.
Why do humans need sleep?
What's the difference between weather and climate?
Why is laughter contagious?
What makes a good friendship last?
What's something you wish people understood better about loneliness?
